genes.name: Alport syndrome
genes.role: Alpha-5 chain of GBM type IV collagen: underproduction and faulty network assembly; hematuria with hearing loss and eye findings, onset at 5-20 years

genes.name: Alport syndrome
genes.role: Alpha-3 chain of GBM type IV collagen; the less common recessive inheritance of the same hereditary nephritis

genes.name: Thin basement membrane disease
genes.role: Alpha-3 or alpha-4 collagen chain change gives a diffusely attenuated GBM: familial asymptomatic hematuria, no hearing or eye loss, normal renal function

genes.name: Thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura
genes.gene: ADAMTS13 mutation (inherited; less common than autoantibody)
genes.role: Metalloproteinase that trims von Willebrand factor multimers; most cases are acquired autoantibodies, treated with plasma exchange

genes.name: Atypical hemolytic uremic syndrome
genes.role: About half of cases: complement activation goes unchecked and injures endothelium, with no diarrheal prodrome and a worse course

genes.name: Atypical hemolytic uremic syndrome
genes.gene: Complement factor I or CD46 (membrane cofactor protein) mutation
genes.role: Loss of another complement regulator, the explanation in patients without the commoner regulator defect
